assumptions.statement: FAR, building height, coverage, setbacks, road redlines, parking, utilities, engineering constraints, surveyed Time Mark component locations and approved phase implementation footprints are not available in cleared official materials.
assumptions.impact: All intensity, massing, transport and utility proposals remain conceptual interfaces rather than statutory or engineering conclusions. Time Mark component siting and actual phase implementation footprints remain unknown pending survey, official data, project siting, approvals and professional review.

assumptions.statement: Submitted site and key-area polygons are repository provisional geometries fitted to announced text and approximate areas. PHASE-001..003 intentionally reuse SITE-001 as overlapping cross-area eligibility envelopes, while TIME-MARK-01..12 are schematic public-space envelopes rather than component footprints or modelled service catchments.
assumptions.impact: All derived maps and area metrics must be regenerated when official polygons are released. Phase-envelope areas and Time Mark public-space quantities are package-internal conceptual measures only; actual implementation footprints and component siting remain unknown.

assumptions.statement: The repository provisional polygon named Dazhongsi AI Industry Cluster has a centroid near Beijing North Railway Station, about 2.26 km from Dazhongsi metro station, as documented in public Issue #1029.
assumptions.impact: The polygon is retained without an invented relocation, but all Dazhongsi spatial moves are directional concepts only; official key-area geometry must trigger recalculation of geometry, metrics, figures, evidence matrices and bilingual narrative anchors.

assumptions.statement: No cleared building survey, structural condition, use, age or ownership dataset is available.
assumptions.impact: Building footprints represent reversible module envelopes; no real building is designated for demolition.

assumptions.statement: Cleared heritage protection and construction-control polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Landmarks and public-space elements remain non-contact, reversible concepts pending heritage review.

assumptions.statement: Official road sections, station interfaces, pedestrian counts and kerb/parking baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Cross-links express survey priorities and must not be interpreted as road or bridge alignments.

assumptions.statement: Project-area public-facility capacity and demographic baselines are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Service locations and capacity are directional; no facility quota or eligibility promise is made.

assumptions.statement: The Slow Variables Council, Clock Contract and annual events are proposed operating mechanisms.
assumptions.impact: They do not represent confirmed government organisation, funding, procurement or partnerships.
